newsitem.title: SPAIN: POLL-Most Spaniards see economic improvement.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Most Spaniards see economic improvement.

text.p: A July survey showed on Wednesday that 32 percent of Spaniards see the nation's economic situation as good or very good, up from 24 percent in April and 16 percent in July 1996.

According to a Demoscopia poll published by newspaper El Pais, 36 percent of those surveyed still see the economic situation as "fair," an unchanged percentage versus the previous poll, while 31 percent believe the economy is performing badly or very badly, down from 39 percent in April 1997.

In response to a question on personal economic situation at home in the last few months, 15 percent said their position had improved (up from 14 percent in April), 65 percent said it was unchanged (up from 64 percent) and 19 percent said it had worsened (down from 21 percent).
Demoscopia interviewed 1,200 Spaniards from July 7 to 9.
